Subject: VIP Exclusive: 20% Off the Northbay Beacon Headlamp — This Sunday Only
Preview: 400 lumens. 40 hours. 95 grams. Your exclusive member discount ends Sunday.
Body: You've put in the miles. You know what a headlamp needs to do at 4 a.m. on a switchback or inside a wet tent at the end of a long day.

As one of our VIP members, you're getting exclusive early access to 20% off the Northbay Beacon Headlamp (NB-LMP-05) — and this offer closes Sunday.

Here's what the Beacon does:

• 400 lumens of output — enough to read the trail well ahead of your feet on a moonless night.
• Up to 40 hours of runtime — that's multiple nights out before you need a charge.
• USB-C rechargeable — one less cable to track down before a trip.
• 95 grams — light enough that you'll forget it's on your head.

It's a focused tool built for backpacking, camping, and pre-dawn starts. It is not built for technical diving or industrial work.

This 20% discount is exclusive to VIP members and expires Sunday. Use it on your next trip out.
